values.note: $10/night for a single site, paid at self-service stations by the toilets near sites 5, 8, 11 and 20. The facility also lists a $20 double site; recreation.gov does not say which number it is.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351788/rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-04-03 to 2026-11-30: WalkInSingleCampsite $10 (STANDARD NONELECTRIC), WalkInDoubleCampsite $20) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/williams-river-sites ('four bulletin boards and self-service stations located beside the toilets near Sites 5, 8, 11, and 20'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Sites are not reservable. Sites are on a first come, first serve basis.' Checkout 2 pm; one motorhome or trailer, 8 people and 2 vehicles per site. A forest order restricts camping along the Williams River to these designated sites (and Tea Creek and Day Run campgrounds).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/williams-river-sites ('Sites are not reservable. Sites are on a first come, first serve basis'; 'Maximum length of stay is 14 days'; 'Single site limit is one wheeled camping unit only, defined as motorhome or travel trailer; no more than 8 people; no more than 2 vehicles') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/cranberry-and-williams-river-camping-areas (Order 09-21-12-05), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Seasons of use: mid-March to the end of November. Toilets are closed in winter.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/williams-river-sites ('Seasons of Use: mid-March - end of November'; 'Toilets are closed in winter'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351788 (notice 'No RV hookups are available'; all sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, 'Water Hookup: No' in the RIDB campsite catalog), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites 25-30 on FR 216, back-in spurs except pull-through site 26; catalog driveway lengths 28-72 ft (25: 71, 26: 72, 27: 40, 28: 29, 29: 33, 30: 28).

sites.source: https://ridb.recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 10351788 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20: per-site Driveway Entry / Driveway Length) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/williams-river-sites, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Vault toilets spaced along the river corridor (closed in winter); each site has a picnic table, fire ring and lantern post. No drinking water: the nearest dump and water fill are in Richwood and Marlinton (Cranberry Campground has a donation dump).

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351788 ('Vautl toilets are spaced along the river corridor'; amenities Vault Toilets, Accessible Vault Toilets, Picnic Tables, Campfire Rings, Lantern Posts) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/williams-river-sites ('Potable water is not available at this site'; 'Dump station and water fill are available in Richwood ...'), read 2026-10-21

note: High-elevation campsites on FR 216 (southern section of Williams River Road), many of which are right on the river.  Note that FR 216 is a narrow gravel road.  --AWH
summary: Forest Service designated FCFS sites (Marlinton Ranger District, above the Highland Scenic Highway): confirmed $10 single-site fee (rec.gov FCFS season), now manual; booking changed to first-come only, not reservable, 14-day max (overrides the inherited rec.gov row); season mid-March to Nov 30; no hookups; vault toilets, no potable water; sites note with catalog driveway lengths (pull-through site 26). Count 6 left as derived. Note: dropped the restated count.
flags: Road closure (not a status): Forest Order 09-21-02-26-04 (July 8 - Nov 30, 2026) closes NFS Road 86 'beyond any road-construction barriers', the closure 'shifting east and south ... as construction progresses' between 38.3579,-80.4216 and 38.3004,-80.2051; the July 17 release closes FR 86 'from the intersection of FR 216 to the intersection with WV Route 150 starting Monday, 20 July 2026'. Access from Dyer to the west is maintained 'whenever possible'. https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/national-forest-system-road-86-closure-public-health-and-safety Entry 115 is on FR 216 (38.251,-80.228), past the order's east end; FR 216 itself is not named, but the FR 86 approach from WV 150 to FR 216 is closed from July 20.

Phone missing: recreation.gov lists 304-846-2695 (Gauley Ranger District) for the facility; these upper sites are administered by the Marlinton Ranger District per https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/williams-river-sites, which is a better primary website than the rec.gov facility page (which takes no reservations).
